description.value: Mostafa Coffee House is a family-run Afghan bakery and café on Edmonds Street in Burnaby, specializing in freshly baked goods made daily from scratch. The menu centres on Afghan baking traditions, with mixed cookies, baklava trays, and Turkish delight among the signatures. A touring cyclist stopping through the Edmonds neighbourhood will find a neighbourhood café with a warm, artisan feel.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 67m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the OSM address (7411 Edmonds St, Burnaby, BC) and business name exactly. The site provides a phone number (604-521-7979) absent from OSM tags, and reveals a minor internal inconsistency: the contact page lists mostafacoffeehouse@hotmail.com while the footer repeats mostafacoffeehouse@gmail.com. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null.
concerns: Email inconsistency on the business's own website: the Contact page lists mostafacoffeehouse@hotmail.com while the site-wide footer lists mostafacoffeehouse@gmail.com.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café with a confirmed address and working website; a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Burnaby's Edmonds corridor.

wow_evidence: family-run Afghan bakery and café... specializing in freshly baked goods made daily from scratch
